recap.label: Daily Recap
recap.periodEnd: Wed, Nov 11, 2026, 4:00 PM ET (that day's close)
recap.timezoneNote: All times below are shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per WSJ, U.S. stocks rose as CoreWeave's earnings update eased worries that AI profits would not come soon enough to cover infrastructure debt burdens (4:23 PM ET), and Nasdaq jumped after the update re-energized the AI trade (2:36 PM ET). The FT reported the Nasdaq erased last week's losses as CoreWeave's results and the prospect of a higher Anthropic IPO valuation boosted sentiment (4:04 PM ET), and Bloomberg reported the Nasdaq 100 nearly erased its losses since the U.S. midterm election as dip buyers returned (8:28 AM ET). WSJ reported European chip stocks climbed after CoreWeave's results (4:25 AM ET). On rates, WSJ reported Asian bond yields rose on growing expectations for a Fed rate hike next month after hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation data (1:37 AM ET), and gold futures settled back under $4,000 for a second session as inflation worries kept rate-hike expectations up (2:47 PM ET). WSJ reported crude futures stabilized after recent losses while the market awaited clarity on talks to end the U.S.-Iran conflict (4:27 PM ET). The U.S. Treasury market was closed for Veterans Day. Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

cryptoDriver.text: CoinDesk reported bitcoin sat out the stock rebound as ETF outflows extended to a fourth day (6:37 AM ET), and that bitcoin barely moved on the hot CPI report as ETF selling slowed (7:19 AM ET). The Block reported stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion, the largest contraction since the 2022 bear market, with USDT and USDC supply down nearly $11 billion over the past month (12:23 PM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

morning.label: Morning Brief
morning.timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per Bloomberg, a tech rebound stalled Wednesday as a leadership crisis at Nvidia threatened wider fallout across the AI supply chain (Nov 11, 5:08 PM ET). Overnight, WSJ reported Nvidia dragged U.S. index futures lower and put the brakes on the AI rally (4:53 AM ET), Asian equities were broadly lower with some support for Chinese stocks on bets that domestic suppliers could gain share (1:46 AM ET), and European stocks rose as investors rotated away from AI (3:23 AM ET). Bloomberg reported AMD and Broadcom gained on bets they may win business from Nvidia (Nov 11, 9:56 PM ET), and long-dated Treasuries rose as trading resumed after the holiday, with Nvidia turmoil encouraging demand for safer assets (Nov 11, 7:58 PM ET). Bloomberg reported gold fell below $4,000 an ounce on persistent U.S. inflation and expectations of Fed rate hikes (7:12 PM ET). WSJ reported oil prices fell as investors weighed U.S.-Iran diplomacy (2:29 AM ET) and China's SMIC posted record revenue and doubled profit (6:31 AM ET). Written from headlines and publisher summaries only.

cryptoDriver.text: CoinDesk reported bitcoin dipped alongside Nvidia as spot bitcoin ETF outflows reached a fifth day; separately, WSJ reported MSCI ruled Strategy ineligible for its global indexes.
